answer_a: Zanen wani tsarin mandala da ruwan fenti

question: Dangane da ka'idar Bowlby, wane ne daga cikin waɗannan bayanai ya yi daidai da halayyar shaƙuwa?
answer_a: Hakan wata hanya ce da take ɗorewa har zuwa farkon shekarun rayuwa
answer_b: Alaƙa ce da dole ta zama tsayayyiya kuma mai ɗorewa don tabbatar da ci gaba mai kyau
answer_c: Wata alaƙa ce wadda take kayyade dukkan dangantakar motsin rai a rayuwa da ci gaba
answer_d: Ita ce dangantaka ta farko ta jariri da mahaifiyarsa, kuma ba wanda zai iya maye gurbinta.
